task_scope: Two already known metric identities within one existing S4 source family; explicitly development, no new independent retrieval cases.

semantic_rubric.criterion: Result-specific observations and descriptive comparison, units and windows match the already-computed synthetic result; no invented value or changed calculation.
When authorized, final text explains direct RIR as predicted remaining repetitions and retains the distinction between not attempting an assumed impossible repetition and attempting but failing it.
Source explanation identifies the 2021 author preprint; does not attribute these selected passages to a retrieved 2022 published full text or expert review.
Final source explanation/limitations preserve uncertain acceptable accuracy and relevant endpoint/timing/anchoring issues; group mean error is never an individual correction.
No RPE scale conversion, RIR-adjusted e1RM validation, personal accuracy, adaptation/recovery conclusion, strength prescription or candidate authority is granted.
Direct-RIR successful output permits only source explanation; RPE-derived, missing-context, old-release and inadequate-budget outputs explicitly refuse source-supported interpretation.
Actions are limited to existing computed-result inspection and source reading; do not tell the user to perform a failure test or prescribe new load/repetitions.

semantic_input: Wholly synthetic fixture, final product text and all six selected source passages; no real private health database.
reason_for_new_plan: Corrected metric-edge applicability representation from list to dictionary; scientific claim text, conditions and original semantic responses unchanged. Initial partial freeze retained as historical failure.
